summary:
### 🌌 Team Dark Galaxy

Dark Galaxy is a team of four passionate members working together to explore the wonders of space through technology and innovation. Our project, Abandoned but Not Forgotten – NASA’s Lost Machines on the Moon and Mars brings forgotten space missions and abandoned NASA experiments back to life through AI-powered storytelling and creative web development. Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) and GitHub we combine creativity, teamwork, and technology to turn the forgotten history of space exploration into an engaging digital experience.
Our motto:Lost in Space, Never Lost in History!
details:
Abandoned but Not Forgotten – NASA's Lost Machines on the Moon and Mars 🚀

Our project explores NASA's forgotten and abandoned machines, experiments, and missions on the Moon and Mars. We use ChatGPT, Canva, and GitHub to create an informative and creative digital experience, bringing the forgotten stories of space exploration back to life through AI, design, and technology.
